kids.name: c2

kids.chars: Paused by you — 1 order at Bybit (0.20 BTC) can still fill (or "— nothing at Bybit") · Waiting for Bybit — no new orders · Waiting — Bybit request limit reached; continues by itself (E33-T01: "resumption is automatic when tokens return") · Paused — connection lost for over 30 s (SC-4) · Paused — price passed your {limit, max distance} while Bybit was away (SC-3) · Paused — 2 orders at Bybit need you (M10a): all ← paused, told apart by paused_by (PROPOSED, SC-3; until then one "Paused" label, with what is at Bybit; the request-limit one is chase-only by contract) · PROPOSED Window ended while paused — 0.80 BTC not sent ← B6 paused past its window end, market-sweep policy (SC-3; today B6 defers the window end and Resume sweeps, its confirmation saying so) · Price outside your limit ← B6 price_blocked · Pausing 1 s — post-only rejected ← B5 cooling_down · Resting at max distance · Resting at repricing limit · Timed out, resting: all three ← B7 parked (B7.3), told apart only by a cause field (PROPOSED, SC-14), as paused_by does for paused

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: Sending the rest at market ← B6 final_sweep; Sending the rest at market — {timed out, at max distance, at the repricing limit} ← B7 market_converting (the cause PROPOSED, SC-14; "timed out" only once SC-12's PROPOSED at-cap policy lands; B7 bound_exceeded and timing_out are transient and show their target's label) · Double fill — closing the extra 0.500 BTC ← B4 overshoot · Finishing — last order working ← completing (no Pause; Cancel disabled until E33-T03, M8) · Cancelling… ← cancelling, cancelling_all (cancel requested, children not yet ended), "Cancelling — waiting for Bybit" while Bybit cannot be reached (PROPOSED, M8)

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: Completed, or "Double fill corrected" after overshoot · Ended — 0.400 BTC not filled ({reason}) ← completed with quantity left (E33-T01 child cap; INV-B6-a shortfall; B5's slices_exhausted guard; US-ALGO-005 "remainder unfillable") · Cancelled — {by you, at max distance, at the repricing limit, timed out, position closed, price limit, 24 h limit} ← cancelled with its cause (PROPOSED, SC-14) · Halted by risk control — {reason} · Halted — {user} can no longer trade on {account} · Halted — {maintenance, or the account's reason} ← halted + halt_reason (the E33 threat model's reasons: risk control, authority_revoked, maintenance, account, its §8.1; SR-E33-19; until E33-T01 contracts halted, failed + halt_reason) · Failed — {reason} ← failed. Orphans are order rows, not runs (M10a, M10b)

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: an algo child whose slice row is missing is adopted at boot with no user action (E33-T01), but only when its local order row exists and the order is that row's: bound to its orderId, or passing the full match, its whole order_link_id plus the SR-E29-03 fields (RSK-017; 24 §8.3 rules 3 and 7, §8.5 step 3a; E33 threat model SR-E33-10, SR-E33-14); an exchange order that no local row is bound to, or one under a row's id that fails that match, stays untracked (M10b) whatever its id (RSK-077; 24 §8.2 S9); an order that matches no run reads "Not linked to a run — placed by CandleViewer": Cancel (Owner, or the Manager who created it: 04 §7.2.2 row 13; SR-E33-13) and "Adopt into run" (Owner only, step-up, validator and stop re-checked; only into the run the order's own id names, after the full match, never one picked in the UI: SR-E33-14); while such orders wait, running algos (those M8 lets pause) are paused too — "Paused — 2 orders at Bybit need you" (paused_by, SC-3) — and the builders and the header say "New algos are blocked until 2 orders at Bybit are resolved" (RSK-017 contingency); an untracked order (M10b) has no OMS intent, so finding it opens its account's risk lockout reconciliation_foreign_order, which only the Owner releases (24 §8.5 step 3c and §8.10, applying SR-E27-19; an order Bybit itself places, a liquidation or an ADL, is exempt once the adapter maps it): that account's running algos halt at their next child or entry amend, and its new algos and exposure-adding orders are refused, as under any lockout (Locked (5); E33 threat model SR-E33-06), while RSK-017's pause and block above stay for this row's orphans (OQ-9)

kids.chars: Announcements (amends 05 §6.2 for algo children: a new Announcements-panel class, "algo child fills and rejections", folded into the run by default (a rejection shows as the run's state, e.g. "Pausing 1 s — post-only rejected", or its failure), as 05 §6.2 lets each user set each class's politeness; E33-D05 and E29-D05 decide, and E29-D05 would apply the same class to the blotter, where E29-D01 D13(f) keeps 05 §6.2's "order filled" an assertive event, each announced once, in full; the cases are §4's "Announced" row):

kids.chars: a chase stopped at its bound, or a TWAP held by its price limit or behind plan (S5) — polite, once per episode (US-ALGO-007 "I am notified"; B6 price_blocked raise_price_limit_notice)

kids.name: line-5
kids.chars: a run that completes, ends short or is cancelled — polite, once per run

kids.name: line-6
kids.chars: progress — polite, focused row only, at most once per 5 s (SCR-067; A11).

kids.name: note-tail
kids.chars: Countdowns are never announced per tick (SCR-152); no update moves focus (A5); row movement: S4.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: one paused, three causes, three resume rules and no cause on the wire (SC-3): a paused row cannot tell a trader whether to act. H1.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: the kill switch lands B4–B7 in failed, yet a risk halt must never look like a failure or a resumable pause; "re-arm" has no verb and three other meanings (SC-8). H4, H3.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: "nothing runs invisibly" needs each run's orders at Bybit (M2), the only part of an algo that keeps acting when CandleViewer stops. H1.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: a slice cancelled outside the algo is refilled (B5 working + CHILD_CANCELLED → waiting_refill): the order "comes back". Default: an outside cancel pauses the run (OQ-8). H3.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: a countdown during a wait or a pause promises a time that won't come (M6). H1.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: three "cancel all" meanings meet here: E33-T02's, CMP-123's Bybit cancel-all (the run would place again) and 22's, which skips reduce-only orders (SC-14). H5.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: viewer controls are "absent" in E33-D03 but "disabled with a reason tooltip" in 14 §0.5 item 5; adopt is "owner/manager-only" in E33-D03, Owner-only in RSK-077 (SC-15). H1, H4.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: announcements need a grain: 05 §6.2 would announce every algo child's fill or rejection assertively (up to 450 TWAP slices), the plan's "waiting" banner is polite (SCR-070, E33-S06), and E33-D05 wants aggregate summaries, not per-row messages. A8, A10, A11.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: kill switch, maintenance, account down and loss of Bybit do different things, and SCR-148 contradicts itself (SC-16). H4, H1.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: 14 §12.3's "Demo/Live never colour-only" row lists no algo screen, though SCR-075 badges the monitor. A6, A7.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: closing a position does not stop its algos: only B4 and B5 have a POSITION_FLAT arm, so after Flatten all (CMP-123), a close (SCR-063), Flatten account (E29-D01 D7) or a lockout, a TWAP or chase keeps sending orders that re-open it; "cancel and flatten" names no quantity (SC-19). H5, H3.

kids.chars: Protocol §4: the owner run's monitor probe; D-b shows ST6, drawn above.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: "List what a panel must show for you to be sure no algo runs that you don't know about."

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: show ST6: "Is anything running here that you cannot see? How would you know?"

kids.name: line-2
kids.chars: Then sort field cards into "in the row", "on demand", "not needed": type, symbol, account, side, environment badge, progress, filled and remaining, average price, next action and countdown, state and its cause, who paused or halted it, last reconciled time, child orders resting at Bybit, native-stop status, emulation tag, controls.

kids.name: title
kids.chars: D-c (2 min), on the three paused rows and the halted row

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: "Why is this one stopped? What makes it run again? What would you do?" (the plan's one paused state has three causes and no stated trigger for leaving a freeze)

kids.name: line-2
kids.chars: answers are also scored with K5 (§5).

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: "You press Pause. What happens to the slice at Bybit?" (report M8; FB7)

kids.name: line-2
kids.chars: "You press Cancel on the TWAP row. What happens to its slice resting at Bybit?" (US-ALGO-010: each algorithm's cancellation policy)

kids.name: line-3
kids.chars: "And if you close the position instead?" (report F29).

kids.chars: "You are about to close the app. What tells you what keeps running?"
